resources.string: No API key configured. Add your key in Settings → AI Provider.
Failed to process the image. Try another photo.
Could not understand the AI response. Please try again.
Invalid API URL. Check your provider settings.
You appear to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
Could not connect to the AI provider. Check your connection and provider URL, then try again.
The AI took too long to respond. Try again, or raise the request timeout in Settings → AI Provider.
Your AI account is out of credits. Top up, or switch provider in Settings → AI Provider.
Your AI account’s daily quota is used up. Try again tomorrow, or switch provider in Settings → AI Provider.
Your AI account’s usage quota was exceeded. Check your provider’s limits, or switch provider in Settings → AI Provider.
The selected model or API endpoint is unavailable. Check the model and API URL in Settings → AI Provider.
Rate limit hit on your API key. Wait a minute, or switch provider in Settings → AI Provider. If you use a free tier, check whether its daily quota is used up.
Your API key was rejected. Open Settings → AI Provider and re-paste a valid key.
The AI provider is overloaded right now. We retried a few times — try again in a minute, or switch provider/model in Settings → AI Provider.
The AI request failed. Try again, or switch provider in Settings → AI Provider.
The on-device AI runtime is unavailable. Check the downloaded model in Settings → AI Provider.
The AI response was truncated twice. Try a shorter input or another model.
